startup.module_load_rule: Hold FCPO low and USB isolated until rail stable and >100ms startup guard elapsed

storage.temperature_factors_status: Engineering allowances; confirm with manufacturer curves and measurements. Endurance limits are conditional qualification tests.
storage.note: Time is a ZERO incremental-converter-current envelope, not a modem burst duration. Integrate actual load minus converter current.
storage.discharge_rule: POWER off / detach, verify TP505 <0.1V before changing modules or profile. 10s nominal service wait is not a substitute for measurement.

recharge.repeated_event_rule: Average deficit energy per period must remain below the available surplus; capacitance cannot cover sustained overload. Duration/frequency must come from measured module activity.

loop_model.scope: Exploratory averaged small-signal model; typical IC gains and assumed inner pole; no nonlinear current-limit handoff or switching model.
